package rulefixtures

import "database/sql"

// scenario for full_dataset_load: Calls that load an entire payload into memory instead of streaming.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

type User struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

func scenario498Positive(db *sql.DB) ([]User, error) {
	rows, err := db.Query("SELECT id, name FROM users")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var all []User
	for rows.Next() {
		var u User
		if err := rows.Scan(&u.ID, &u.Name); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		all = append(all, u)
	}
	return all, rows.Err()
}
